items.title: HPE Is the Quiet AI Winner Trading Near Its 52-Week High
items.summary: HPE just shattered its 52-week high on a single session surge, yet its forward multiple still sits far below every major competitor building the same AI infrastructure boom. Something in the valuation math does not add up.

items.title: HPE Networking Outlook Gets Boost as Barclays, Citi and Wells Fargo Raise Price Targets
items.summary: Citi, Barclays, and Wells Fargo all lifted their HPE price targets after Networking Investor Day, yet the three firms land in very different places on whether the stock's explosive run has already consumed the upside.

items.title: The Boring Tech Stock With an AI Tailwind Has 17% Upside
items.summary: Cisco just posted its fifth straight earnings beat while AI infrastructure orders piled up faster than Wall Street expected, yet the stock sits nearly 18% below its 52-week high. Something does not add up, and the answer could mean serious upside for patient investors.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, S&P 500 Finds Key Support As Micron Earnings Crush Views; Oil Prices, Treasury Yields In Focus
items.summary: Futures: The S&P 500 is trying to bounce off its 50-day line amid high oil prices and Treasury yields. Micron earnings easily beat.

items.title: Micron Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Pricing and AI Demand
items.summary: MU's Q4 earnings surge as stronger DRAM and NAND pricing, AI demand and data center growth drive record revenues and margins.

items.title: 2 Services Stocks with Impressive Fundamentals and 1 Facing Challenges
items.summary: Business services providers play a critical role for enterprises, assisting them with everything from new hardware integrations to consulting and marketing. Market leaders have certainly capitalized on outsourcing trends and digital transformation initiatives to boost sales, helping fuel a 22.1% gain for the industry over the past six months - 5.5 percentage points higher than the S&P 500.

items.title: Why Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of enterprise technology company Hewlett Packard Enterprise (NYSE:HPE) jumped 3.7% in the morning session after the company announced a $1.2 billion AI system order and raised its multi-year networking outlook ahead of its Networking Investor Day.
